setting: The Shattered Expanse — a realm where forgotten gods whisper through black holes and stars bleed memories.

mainCharacter.name: Lyra the Voidwalker
mainCharacter.title: The Last Starchild
mainCharacter.description: A wanderer born from a dying star, carrying the last flame of creation.
mainCharacter.motivation: To reignite the cosmic forge before the universe forgets how to dream.

villain.name: The Silence
villain.title: The Eater of Realities
villain.description: An ancient absence that does not destroy, but makes things un-happen.
villain.motivation: To return all existence to a state of perfect, silent nothingness where no story was ever told.

objective: Traverse the three layers of reality to find the lost Echo of the First Word and sing existence back into being.

intro.ar: ولدت من رحم نجم يحتضر، وفي يدك شعلة الخلق الأخيرة. الكون يذوي في صمت رهيب، والعدم يزحف من أطراف الزمن ليبتلع كل شيء. لا أحد يذكر اسمك، ولكنك آخر أمل للوجود.
intro.en: You were born from a dying star, the last flame of creation in your hand. The universe is fading into a terrible silence, and nothingness creeps from the edges of time to devour everything. No one remembers your name, but you are the last hope of existence.

winMessage.ar: تردد صدى الكلمة الأولى عبر الأكوان، وانفجرت النجوم من جديد! لقد أعدت كتابة الواقع وأيقظت الحلم الكوني.
winMessage.en: The Echo of the First Word reverberated across the multiverse, and stars ignited anew! You have rewritten reality and awakened the cosmic dream.

loseMessage.ar: الصمت اكتمل. لم يعد هناك صوت، ولا لون، ولا ذكرى. وجودك تلاشى وكأنه لم يكن أبداً.
loseMessage.en: The Silence is complete. There is no sound, no color, no memory. Your existence faded as if it had never been.

scenes.description: Clouds of stardust whisper tales of worlds that no longer exist.
An ocean of absolute nothingness where even light drowns.

choices.consequence: Sacrifice a part of yourself to create a new star
Risk everything to retrieve a lost memory
